<translate>
The '''Invincible Armor''' is a special armor set that you can't craft: it is one of the wishes of [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]], the Namek dragon. It comes in two colors, each with its own wish, and each wish gives the full set: helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots. In game, the pieces are named '''Super Hero Armor''' (Invincible).
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting it ==

Gather the seven Namek Dragon Balls, summon Porunga and choose one of these wishes (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragons and Wishes|Dragons and Wishes]]):

* '''Invincible Armor''';
* '''Invincible Armor (Blue)'''.

Porunga grants three wishes per summon, so you can take both sets in the same summon.
</translate>

<translate>
== Protection ==

The pieces use the same Kikono armor material as the crafted sets, with the same armor points, toughness and knockback resistance (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Armor#Defense and resistance|Armor]]).
</translate>
